pipeline_params.description: NuRoute Artemis Task (https://nuroute.ai) -- routes each query across NuRoute's production model pool: it estimates the query's task types, reads each model's expected quality and cost for them from a capability matrix, and picks the model with the best quality-for-cost trade-off (Balanced preset). Predictions come from NuRoute's production API with model "auto"; not trained or tuned on RouterArena data.
